title: U Mass - Hyperglycemic Clamp Protocol
author: Jason Kim
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xzafp2e

steps.title: Perform Survival Surgery
steps.instruction: Establish a chronic indwelling catheter for intravenous infusion 5~6 days prior to the experiment.

substeps.instruction: Refer to M1023: Surgery-jugular vein cannulation

steps.title: Fast Mice
steps.instruction: Fast mice overnight (~15 hours) or for 5 hours prior to the start of the experiment.

steps.title: Prepare Mouse for Infusion
steps.instruction: Secure the mouse and prepare the catheter for infusion.

substeps.instruction: Place the mouse in a rat-size restrainer with its tail tape-tethered at one end
Expose and flush the intravenous catheter using saline solution
Connect the catheter to the CMA Microdialysis infusion pump

steps.title: Collect Basal Plasma Sample
steps.instruction: Collect a 20 µl plasma sample before the start of infusion (basal-0 min) to measure basal glucose and insulin levels.

steps.title: Initiate Hyperglycemic Clamp
steps.instruction: Start infusion of 20% dextrose to quickly reach and maintain a target hyperglycemia of ~300 mg/dl glucose level.

substeps.instruction: Adjust glucose infusion rates to maintain the target hyperglycemia

steps.title: Monitor Glucose and Insulin Levels
steps.instruction: Collect plasma samples at 10, 20, 30, 45, 60, 90, and 120 min to monitor glucose and insulin concentrations.

substeps.instruction: Collect 10 µl plasma samples at each time point to measure glucose levels
Collect 10 µl plasma samples at each time point to measure insulin concentrations
Adjust glucose infusion rates based on instantaneous glucose levels to maintain target hyperglycemia

steps.title: Euthanize and Collect Tissues
steps.instruction: Euthanize the mice at the end of the experiment and collect the pancreas if required for further studies.
